answer: Proposed voting rule: each identity needs 30 minutes of supervised cedar nursery work monthly, iris checks against templates in a protected vault, and a random spoken echo challenge. Registrars sign timed attendance and reject matches to other identities. Renewal must match the enrolled iris, so work cannot be delegated. Thus n active identities require n people and 30n person-minutes monthly. Missing renewal disables voting. Corrupt registrars, biometric spoofing and paid recruits remain threats; false matches exclude people and stored biometrics risk privacy.
